record.name: Operator
record.description: Bounty Hunter Operators leverage vehicles, drones, and pursuit technology to track, intercept, and disable targets with surgical efficiency.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Operators are master trackers and tacticians who use advanced technology to outmaneuver their prey.

progression_tree.description: Your training and experience have improved your ability to detect hidden dangers, allowing you to sense the presence of enemies even when they're not in line of sight.
You have developed a keen sense of spatial awareness, allowing you to gain advantage on initiative rolls in combat when using your ranged attacks.

effects.notes: As a master tactician, the Operator instinctively anticipates and adapts to the enemy's movements, granting themselves advantage on initiative rolls with ranged attacks.

progression_tree.description: Your training and experience have improved your vehicle handling skills, allowing you to move at higher speeds while maintaining control.

effects.value: Increase speed of land or air vehicles by 10ft.

progression_tree.description: You have developed a network of contacts and informants, allowing you to gather valuable information about potential targets and their security measures.

effects.value: Gain access to local law enforcement records and surveillance feeds.

progression_tree.description: You have refined your tactical protocols, allowing you to execute complex operations with ease and precision.

effects.value: Specialize in executing complex operations with multiple targets.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a wide, balanced stance with feet shoulder-width apart, ready to pounce into action at a moment's notice.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Exudes an aura of intense focus and tracking prowess, surrounded by swirling patterns of blue and green light that shift and adapt to the surroundings.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A skilled Operator from the Empire's elite bounty hunter corps, clad in matte-black armor with a distinctive red stripe running down the arms, stalking its prey through the dense forests of Kashyyyk.
contextual_modifiers: Include a faint image of a tracking droid hovering nearby
Depict the Operator crouched behind a tree, gazing intently through a targeting scope
